name: LightUSD
role: Dependency-free USD reader/writer (.usda, .usdc, .usdz) via a pip wheel or npm
summary: A C++17 USD library (formerly TinyUSDZ) with Python and WASM/npm bindings. The Python wheel creates a stage in code and saves .usda, .usdc or .usdz by extension, and loads them back. It has no renderer and no Hydra. A 1.0 released 2026-11-09, so young; it installs without Pixar's build.
use_when: Write a small scene as .usda, .usdc or .usdz from Python without building OpenUSD
Inspect or check a USDZ's prims, metadata and time samples as data
Over openusd when only stage data is needed and the install should be one wheel
avoid_when: Rendering, Hydra or usdchecker compliance: Blender or OpenUSD
Production composition: openusd is the reference implementation
license: Apache-2.0 (wheel metadata and README); some MIT helper code per LICENSE.3rdparty

install.macos: cd examples/lightusd-stage-roundtrip && python3.12 -m venv output/venv && output/venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

notes: 2026-11-27: lead matched PyPI (1.0.0, 2026-11-09, Apache-2.0, macOS arm64 abi3 wheel, Python >=3.11). The lead's 'glTF or OBJ conversion not documented' is partly wrong: the module exports import_obj, import_urdf and import_mjcf (untested here).
2026-11-27: the fixture's six reads agree, including usd-core 26.11 reading lightusd's .usda, .usdc and .usdz; usdchecker was not run and nothing was rendered.
2026-11-27: Python API quirks seen: Stage.default_prim returns a Prim, not a name; Relationship.targets are strings; Attribute.timesamples.times is a property.

assessment.rationale: PyPI 1.0.0 (2026-11-09), last push 2026-11-22, Apache-2.0. Young but the write path works: usd-core reads its .usda, .usdc and .usdz. Adds a one-wheel USDZ writer next to openusd, which has no USDZ evidence; overlap is real, so keep as a candidate, not a promotion.

evidence.result: lightusd 1.0.0 authors Xform, Cube, Sphere, material binding, translate samples at frames 0-24, metersPerUnit 0.01, upAxis Y; saves .usda, .usdc, .usdz. lightusd and usd-core 26.11 each read all three: six reads equal (prims, values, metadata, samples, binding, shuffled reads). usdz is one stored root.usdc, data 64-byte aligned. Rerun .usda and .usdz byte-identical. Python 3.12.13, macOS arm64.
evidence.scope: lightusd authors one stage, saves .usda/.usdc/.usdz; lightusd and usd-core 26.11 read equal; no usdchecker, no rendering, no assets in the USDZ; macOS arm64
